survey: A fruit platter on a wooden table. The plate is a shallow, round, clear glass dish seen from about 3/4 above, and its rim forms an even ellipse. A large watermelon slice lies flat at the back. Its red face points at the camera. Green rind runs along the lower curved edge, rising at the left end and up the right side to the tip, and the seeds are spread across the flesh. An orange wedge leans against the watermelon at the back right, with its cut face showing the segments. Another orange wedge lies in front at the left, rind facing down and toward the viewer. In the middle is a cluster of green grapes with no stem, which is a normal simplification. Strawberries sit at the front right and front center, the center one turned so its green leafy top faces the camera. Blueberries rest at the left edge and front right, and all of them are inside the plate rim. Every piece of fruit sits on the plate or leans on another piece. Nothing floats or passes through anything else. The water drops are surface detail, not added parts.
